newsitem.title: portugal: Portuguese shares end on high note, focus on PT.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end on high note, focus on PT.

text.p: 1908 GMT - Portuguese shares rose by more today than they had fallen last Friday with a flurry of late buying, notably of Portugal Telecom.

* The sale of a 35.6 percent stake in mobile phone operator Telecel, one of the biggest flotations in Portuguese history, was heavily oversubscribed and netted 60.8 billion escudos ($388 million), officials said.
* Shares in Telecel TELN.IN should rise sharply at their launch on the Lisbon bourse on Tuesday because of the high level of unsatisfied demand at the public offer to sell (OPV), analysts said.
* Portugal Telecom (PT) rose two percent to 4,227 escudos, a record high, in heavy trade on the back of strong interest from funds and institutions, dealers said.
Dealers said it was an extension of the interest seen last Thursday which had then been interrupted by the big sell-off in financial markets on Friday.
